WF-03 Step 0.5: Issue Registration

GitHub Issue #406: Memory leak in src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson

Symptom: parseGraphJson calls allocator.dupe(u8, n.id) without a matching free, leaking allocations every time a Definition with graph_json is loaded. Surfaced by tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig TC-ISS-601-01 (48 leaks) and TC-ISS-601-05 (42 leaks).

Reproduction:
  BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-iss601
  
Expected: 9/9 PASS. Actual: 6 pass, 1 skip, 2 fail (leak errors at store.zig:1356).

Severity: MAJOR (affects every integration test with Definition + graph_json).

Execute fn:register-issue:
1. Check if ISS-0601-LEAK-001 already exists in docs/issues/
2. If not: create docs/issues/ISS-0601-LEAK-001.json with symptom, root cause, severity MAJOR
3. Update docs/issues/issue_index.json
4. GitHub issue #406 already filed - record URL in the ISS file
5. Return PASS with issue file path in artifacts_out

Do NOT implement any fix in this step - only register the issue.
acceptance_criteria: Issue file contains github_issue field with #406 URL

result.summary: Registered ISS-0601-LEAK-001: memory leak in src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson. Issue already filed as GitHub #406 and documented with symptom, root cause, severity MAJOR.
result.next_action: Route to ISSUE-FIXER Step 1 for diagnosis
